Learn how to crochet the beautiful Timeless Granny Ripple Blanket, an easy, beginner-friendly crochet blanket featuring a classic granny stitch ripple design. This relaxing pattern is worked in simple repeats, making it the perfect project to enjoy while watching your favourite show or unwinding at the end of the day.

Designed with my Timeless Tones Anti-Pilling DK yarn collection, this blanket features five soft pink shades that create a timeless ombré effect. The pattern includes Baby, Medium Throw, and Large Throw sizes, along with a delicate picot edging for a beautiful finished look.

Beginner Tutorials https://youtu.be/xClAx3jsCFk
Pattern Support is only offered in our Community Group https://www.facebook.com/groups/363218121026907/

DIFFICULTY: Beginner 
Written in Standard American Terms

MJ’s Off The Hook Designs Timeless Tones 
DK Weight #3, 100% Premium Acrylic, 273 yds/100 g. Shown in Rosewater (A), Sunset Coral (B), Sweet Peony (C), Petal Pink (D), and Vintage Rose (E).

Sizes & Yardage
Baby: Approx. 32" × 36", 1,100 yds. 1 ball of each colour (5 balls total).
Medium Throw: Approx. 40" × 50", 1,900 yds. 2 balls of each colour (10 balls total).
Large Throw: Approx. 52" × 64", 3,100 yds. 3 balls of each colour (15 balls total).
Yarn amounts are approximate; it is always recommended to grab extra to avoid running short. 
BUY YARN US: https://www.marymaxim.com/products/timeless-tones-anti-pilling-dk-yarn

US H/8 (5 mm)
or the size needed to obtain the gauge

GAUGE
Pattern: 9 stars or 18 sts and 10 rows equal to 4" in pattern with 5.5 mm hook 
Border: 3 Rounds equal to 1"
